verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents deploying custom fine-tuned models on dedicated endpoints alongside standard models. Its Management API lets you upload fine-tuned models from your S3 bucket, track versions and deploy them, so the serving half of the story is first-party. Nothing in the evidence shows Cerebras running the fine-tuning on your own data; training apparently happens elsewhere before upload, and serving is limited to dedicated (not self-serve public) endpoints. Missing for 10: an on-platform fine-tuning/training capability, a documented end-to-end fine-tune-to-serve workflow on the shared tier, and hands-on or independent corroboration of custom model deployment.
